scheme_name: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service
description:
The Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Uttarakhand.

This scheme was launched to provide financial support to the families of employees working under the Uttarakhand Purva Sainik Kalyan Nigam Limited (UPNL) who die while in service.

The scheme was officially implemented on 1st April 2017.

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased employees receive immediate financial assistance during a time of loss.

The ex-gratia payment aims to alleviate the financial burden on the family members left behind by the deceased employee.

The scheme provides a one-time ex-gratia payment of ₹5 lakh to the family of the deceased employee.

This amount is intended to help cover immediate expenses and provide some financial stability to the bereaved family.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and straightforward.

Only employees who are currently serving under the UPNL are eligible for this scheme.

The employee must have died while actively engaged in their duties.

There are no age limits specified for the employees under this scheme.

The family members of the deceased employee must provide necessary documentation to claim the ex-gratia amount.

The application process for this scheme is clearly defined.

The family of the deceased employee must submit an application to the UPNL office.

The application must include a death certificate of the employee.

It should also include proof of relationship to the deceased, such as a marriage certificate or birth certificate.

Additionally, the family must provide identification documents of the deceased employee.

The application must be submitted within six months of the employee's death.

This timeline is crucial to ensure that the family does not miss out on the benefits provided under the scheme.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities at UPNL.

The verification process will include checking the employment status of the deceased employee.

It will also involve confirming the relationship of the applicant to the deceased.

Upon successful verification, the ex-gratia amount will be disbursed.

The payment is typically made through a bank transfer to the designated bank account of the beneficiary.

The UPNL has a dedicated team to handle such applications and ensure timely disbursement of funds.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Uttarakhand Purva Sainik Kalyan Nigam Limited.

The contact details for UPNL can be found on their official website.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Uttarakhand to support its workforce and their families.

This initiative reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of its employees and their dependents.

The ex-gratia payment is designed to provide immediate relief and is not a substitute for any other benefits.

It is a standalone financial assistance program aimed specifically at addressing the needs of families in distress.

The scheme has been positively received by employees and their families.

It has provided a sense of security to employees knowing that their families will be supported in case of an unforeseen event.

The UPNL has been proactive in promoting this scheme among its employees.

Awareness campaigns have been conducted to ensure that employees and their families are informed about the benefits available to them.

The scheme is part of the larger framework of employee welfare initiatives in the state.

It aligns with the government's vision of providing social security to its workforce.

The ex-gratia amount is funded by the state government.

This funding ensures that the scheme remains sustainable and can support families in need.

The scheme also encourages employees to engage in their work with a sense of security.

It fosters a supportive work environment where employees feel valued and cared for.

The UPNL regularly reviews the scheme to ensure it meets the needs of its employees and their families.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for any necessary adjustments to the scheme.

The government has also set up a helpline for families to inquire about the scheme and the application process.

This helpline is intended to provide assistance and guidance to families during a difficult time.

The UPNL aims to process applications as quickly as possible to minimize the waiting period for families.

The scheme has been instrumental in providing timely financial assistance to families in distress.

It serves as a reminder of the government's commitment to employee welfare.

The ex-gratia payment is a crucial lifeline for families who may face financial difficulties after the loss of a breadwinner.

The scheme underscores the importance of social security measures in the workplace.

Overall, the Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service is a vital welfare initiative.

It provides essential financial support to families during a challenging time.

The scheme reflects the government's dedication to ensuring the well-being of its employees and their dependents.

By offering this financial assistance, the government aims to create a more secure and supportive environment for its workforce.

The scheme is a significant step towards enhancing the social security framework in Uttarakhand.

It highlights the importance of providing immediate relief to families in need.

The UPNL continues to work towards improving the welfare of its employees through various initiatives.

This scheme is just one of the many ways the government is striving to support its workforce.

The ex-gratia payment is a testament to the government's commitment to employee welfare and social security.
